importKey.instructions: Introduce tu clave privada en formato nsec1... o como cadena hexadecimal (64 caracteres).

importKey.exampleNote: (esto es solo un ejemplo de formato, no una clave real)

entry.title: Quick Connect
entry.lead: A temporary room for text and voice — no registration, no key exchange beforehand. The room disappears on its own once everyone leaves.
entry.openModeLabel: Allow entry by name and password
entry.openModeHintOn: Anyone who knows the name and password can join.
entry.openModeHintOff: Entry is by invite link only.
entry.anonymityNotice: Entry is always anonymous, even if you're logged into the app — your main account is never revealed. The relay operator sees that the room exists and is active, but not its content.

room.voiceJoinError: Couldn't connect to voice. Check your connection and try again — chat keeps working in the meantime.
room.ephemeralNotice: Messages aren't saved or loaded on join — anyone who joins later won't see the history. A message sent right when the recipient briefly drops offline is lost for good.
room.emptyChat: No messages yet. Send the first one.
